# Native 132 execution and observed-header evidence

These are unchanged original bytes from protected 2.9.132. `provenance.json`
records original and retained source paths, sizes, SHA-256 and whole RGB crop
bounds. The parent evidence manifest retains the exact related diagnostics.

- `apex.png` has only K clubs at fixed one-based `1|1`, positive empty piles,
  no stock control and the literal zero-deal caption. Both complete derived RGB
  signatures supplement the native execution position guard only. They do not
  change ordinary Recon or authorise REDEAL.
- `score-final.png` has an empty tableau, moving Perfect overlay, DL K diamonds,
  empty DR and Score 2510/2900. `score-start.png` supplies its actual initial
  requirement. A replayed final whole-action ACK and the same incomplete bound
  requirement are prerequisites for the complete top-band alternative. This is
  evidence of a board clear, not a challenge win or authority to continue.
- `boards-two.png` is a successful NoChallenge acquisition with Boards 2/3.
  It tests partial-target entry and observed-mode reporting. It is not the
  unidentified failed target-aware 2/3 entry reported by the operator.
- The two deal JSON files are exact packet exports. Test routes use the shared
  checked codec, rules and independent replay; no saved file grants a receipt.

Negative pixel derivatives and mock-QMP frame orderings are labelled synthetic.
No still proves animation duration, actual guest input or full live acceptance.
